selection_metric: mean per-seed rAUEC over 37.5%, 50%, 75%, using paired Uniform
inclusion: same signed reference Cl > 0.01 protocol at every stage

selection.shortlist: top three configurations per family from screening

freeze: one configuration per family after selection; unchanged thereafter

confirmation.identity: not in the stored historical pool inventory or prior budget10 splits

test.identity: existing fixed benchmark; no parameter selection

stopping_rule: complete the declared search and report the result, including no improvement
data_use: truth only for eligibility and offline metrics; sampling uses geometry and predicted pressure
known_operator_history: Existing operator checkpoint was previously selected on IDs 1000:1200; this does not make that benchmark a newly untouched holdout.
